public_rationale: This sentence is a hedged impression. Zitron says the integrated AI 'doesn't actually seem to' do anything new, make a profit, or meet a need. 'Anything new' and 'any particular need' have no plain measure. No major tech company reported profit or loss for its AI features in mid-2024, so the profit part cannot be checked from disclosures either. Some facts cut against the 'need' wording. Microsoft said AI added 7 points to Azure growth, and GitHub Copilot had 1.8 million paid subscribers (e1, e2). But revenue and paid sign-ups are not profit, and they do not settle a subjective claim about novelty or need. So the claim is recorded as not adjudicable.
limitations: A stricter reader could treat paid adoption as contradicting the 'need' part.
Only Microsoft evidence was gathered as context.
